historical_reason.finding: Original Claude co-authored backport explicitly omitted filemap PSI because upstream insertion of PG_workingset would renumber vendor page flags. Kernel7 improved cgroup/trigger coverage but did not close that historical MM omission.

added_features: File-cache historical-active/workingset classification through deactivation, eviction shadows and eligible refault
Memory PSI while waiting for workingset file pages to become uptodate
Working-set read BIO submission PSI and memory-related blkcg throttle annotation
Preserve working-set flag through page migration and compound-page split; clear it at reuse
inherited_features: All kernel7 system/cgroup CPU/memory/IO statistics, quota/full accounting, thresholds and poll/epoll lifetime fixes

abi.scope: Compiled headers with preserved kernel7 baseline; not proof of all proprietary runtime accesses.

qemu.label: psi8-docker
expected_userspace_warnings: WARNING: Support for cgroup v1 is deprecated and planned to be removed by no later than May 2029 (https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/51111)

rootfs.purpose: Kernel/module test rootfs from stock userspace, not an integrated replacement for kernel6-ui1 UI/RGB/collectors.

limits: Anonymous/swap workingset classification, cold/hot swapin-specific PSI and modern reclaim-root LRU behavior are not part of this file-cache stage; full dependencies documented in reports/psi8/mm-feasibility.json.
The optional workingset_restore VM statistic is intentionally not added, preserving vendor VM-stat array layouts; PSI does not depend on this diagnostic counter.
As in selected upstream, legacy direct IO using an already-hot file-backed user buffer may inherit its workingset mark; asynchronous downstream cloned submissions are not separately instrumented.
The use_memdelay block-policy branch is compiled/reviewed; disabled io.latency policy means it is not exercised by these tests.
No IRQ pressure, later average-based unprivileged monitor mode, per-cgroup PSI on/off, userspace oomd policy or SL1680 changes.
Physical kernel8 one-time boot accepted; no radios/Runner throughput benchmark or long soak claimed.
